name: Color Bleeding
description: Detects color bleeding artifacts at boundaries
algorithm: Color Bleeding — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects color bleeding artifacts in video for forensic manipulation detection:

1. **颜色通道分解**: The video is decomposed into YCbCr color space, separating luminance from chrominance. Color bleeding — where color information "leaks" across sharp boundaries — is analyzed by examining chrominance gradients at luminance edges.

2. **边界颜色Spread测量**: At high-contrast edges, the spatial spread of color transitions is measured. Natural color bleeding follows predictable patterns determined by the camera's sensor (Bayer demosaicing) and lens (chromatic aberration). AI-generated content may produce color bleeding that doesn't match any physical imaging model.

3. **Codec-ConsistentBleeding验证**: Video compression produces characteristic color bleeding through chroma subsampling and DCT block boundaries. The method verifies that observed color bleeding is consistent with the video's codec and encoding parameters. Manipulated regions encoded separately may show different bleeding characteristics.

4. **时间颜色Bleeding一致性**: Color bleeding patterns should remain stable across frames for static edges and change predictably with motion. The method tracks color bleeding signatures temporally — deepfake insertion may cause temporal variations in bleeding patterns at manipulation boundaries.

5. **Cross-区域Bleeding比较**: Color bleeding characteristics should be uniform across the frame (same imaging pipeline). The method compares bleeding patterns between face regions and background. Composited deepfake faces may exhibit different color bleeding than the original background footage, indicating content from different sources.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through color bleeding analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频
